If you have already 
survived this entry,  
the steward is  
harmless—go to  
the ship’s activity 
table at 187 . I f

A new steward  
enters, carrying  
fresh towels for  
your stateroom.  
He looks Egyptian.  
Choose one of the 
following; if you 
make a successful 
roll, then go to that 
entry: 
• For a successful Spot Hidden roll, go to 91.
• For a successful Anthropology roll, go to 9.
• For a successful Luck roll, go to 106. 
Otherwise, go to 10.
